svg.title: From a layout to a simulated site
svg.desc: The layout file is the centre of a simulated site: the launcher derives the bay, VECS and VRC nodes from it, the scenario places AGVs and trays on its node ids, and the installation parameter file of the same name tunes the site's hardware.

g.text: From a layout to a simulated site

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: A simulation runs one layout. The launcher starts one set of bay nodes per Bay or BLift node, one VECS per EvCharge node and one VRC driver per vrcs entry; the scenario puts AGVs and trays

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: on the layout's node ids; params_<layout>.yaml, if it exists, carries the site's hardware settings.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
